summary:
Head 717b80201ed201739237f1c967822c1d1ccb7a37 is the merge of main 53272a1 plus checkpoint commits, and nothing else. This is a head check of the spike branch, not a merge to main. I only read and ran nothing; the only file I wrote is my notes file.

1. The merge commit 2bd44a5 (parents 98ffb08 and 53272a1) holds main's changes and nothing more.
   - `git diff 98ffb08 2bd44a5 --name-status` and `git diff 4d21c1a 53272a1 --name-status` list the same 12 files with the same status letters, and both stats read +1327 -108.
   - 8 of the 12 files are byte-equal to main's. DECISIONS.md, REPO_MAP.md and STATUS_ARCHIVE.md differ from main's copies only because the branch had edited them too. For those three, git's own merge (`git merge-tree --write-tree 98ffb08 53272a1`, tree 5456a4a) gives the same files as 2bd44a5, so nobody edited them by hand.
   - STATUS.md is the only file where 2bd44a5 differs from git's merge, and only inside the one conflict (lines 28-34). The result has one #40 row, which differs from main's only in its state cell; main's #52 row, byte for byte; and no #48 row. The file is 120 lines with a trailing newline. That is what merge_main_53.py (committed in e1e97e9) says. The two commits the new state cell cites, 71ee13d and b30314a, exist and are on the branch.
   - The three commits after the merge (6db2d0c, ea95701, 717b802) change only .checkpoints/: the card, plus my two disk-ruling notes in 6db2d0c.

2. The evidence holds.
   - gate-merge.log: GATE PASS with the smoke test skipped (--no-smoke), no symbols added or removed. CI's own smoke covers the skipped test.
   - counted-merge.log: HEAD 2bd44a5, 2,866 MiB free, STOP "under 4 GB free" at 20:57:10.
   - kl-cache.log: free 2,863 MiB before, 6,914 after, .gate/u3c-review-target removed, exit 0. The folder is gone, and the script's cache command removes nothing else (its header). The kit files on disk equal main's (git diff against origin/main is empty).
   - counted-merge-2.log: HEAD ea95701, which is the merge plus checkpoint commits only. The run started at 21:02:53 with 6,913 MiB free, above the 4,096 floor. Both the diff and untracked hashes are the hash of empty input. All 11 steps pass (538 + 616 tests, 0 failed), and the run exited 0 at 21:16:35. The refs step names §4.9's exception. self passes 78 of 78; redact passes 10 of 10 with 0 findings.
   - The refs count of 1,275 is right. Tracked files are 1,273 at 2bd44a5 (my bar used that commit) and 1,275 from 6db2d0c on, which adds my two disk-ruling notes. Both kit files are in ea95701's tracked list.
   - CI on 6db2d0c: gate, toolchain and smoke all succeeded (twice each, 21:02-21:03 UTC). ea95701 and 717b802 are [skip ci], but their tree differs from 6db2d0c only in the card, so that green stands for the head.
   - The run-set folders under .gate/netcode-proof-test/runs/ are untouched: all 10 are still there, nothing in them is newer than 20:50 UTC, and their sizes match the draft's table. Nothing is running now. Free space is 5,889 MiB.

3. The head is ready for the first real list and pack (step 3 of the REFS-KIT order). Details are in first_pack and the conditions.

What I could not check: I did not run the gate or check.mjs myself, because this seat is read-only. I relied on the logs and on CI's check runs.

Notes: /home/user/Shamble-Frontlines/.checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/advisor-merged-head.md (untracked; the session commits it).

findings.where: .checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/history.md:2163 onward (C62H-BOUND-YES: "judge the kept P0 set's logs again") against .gate/netcode-proof-test/runs/u4r-P0-051995db9cea (3,249 MiB) and u4r-P0-93509dfd7fd1 (3,393 MiB)
findings.what: Mustafa's words name one P0 set, but two P0 raw-log folders exist. The rule 'P0's raw logs stay until C62H-BOUND's re-judge' does not say which folder that is, so a later pack could take the one the re-judge needs.
findings.fix: Keep both P0 folders unpacked until the re-judge has run, or until C62H-BOUND's build brief names the one folder it reads. Write that on the card.

findings.where: advisor-disk-deadlock-full.json, step 5's pass bar ("refs PASS on 1,273 tracked files")
findings.what: My bar said 1,273 files; the run read 1,275. The difference is the two disk-ruling notes committed at 6db2d0c (I checked with ls-tree: 2bd44a5 has 1,273, 6db2d0c has 1,275). The bar's number was mine and named the wrong commit, so the evidence holds.
findings.fix: None. The card may record that the 1,275 is explained.

conditions: Before the first list: in the main folder, on the branch at 717b802 (or a later commit that changes only .checkpoints/), confirm that pgrep finds no cargo, rustc, npt-lab, npt-judge, loader.mjs, check.mjs or main-run.sh, that no build or run set is running (C62H-BOUND's build has not started), and that git status shows only .checkpoints/ changes.

One folder only: u4r-precheck-30-faf42aeb034c. Run `node .claude/scripts/kept-logs.mjs list u4r-precheck-30-faf42aeb034c --results spikes/netcode-proof/results/u4r-precheck-30/faf42aeb034c`. Optionally, run the spike's redact-check over spikes/netcode-proof before committing (about 1 s; the list holds only hex hashes, sizes and short paths).

Commit only spikes/netcode-proof/results/u4r-precheck-30/faf42aeb034c/raw-logs.sha256. The commit message names the closed ruling: .checkpoints/netcode-proof-test/advisor-u4r-sets-r2-full.md:45 (U4r's judged runs close; no further run at any U4r set commit), with :63 ('The -30 pre-check as recorded.'), closed on the card and in the report at 6b22cab. Push the commit.

Run `node .claude/scripts/kept-logs.mjs pack u4r-precheck-30-faf42aeb034c --results spikes/netcode-proof/results/u4r-precheck-30/faf42aeb034c`. Copy its 'free before' and 'free after' lines, and its read-back line, onto the card with this ruling. Exit 1 or a refusal means stop: tell Mustafa and pack nothing more until he answers (§11).

Before each later pack, check that free space is at least the folder's size plus 1,024 MiB. The script refuses below that, but also leave room for C62H-BOUND's build floor (projected start checks at 4,983.6 MiB and 4,620.4 MiB). Never pack during a build or a run set.
Both P0 folders (051995db9cea and 93509dfd7fd1) stay unpacked until C62H-BOUND's P0 re-judge has run (MH-L1).
Cite each later set's own closed ruling (file and line) before its list. The script cannot check that a ruling is closed.
